findings.obs_text: In Gen 32:8, 1Sa 27:11, 1Sa 27:12, 2Sa 5:6, 2Ki 7:12, 2Ch 32:1, Neh 6:9 and Psa 64:5 thinking carries H0559, to say, and the quoted sentence that follows gives the thought as inner speech: Jacob's plan for the camps, David's fear of report, Achish's trust, the enemies' hope that the work will stop. In Neh 6:9 H0853 is the object marker in the unit.
findings.grounds: Their hands will drop from the work

findings.obs_text: In Rom 1:21, 1Cor 14:20 and 1Pe 4:1 thinking is the mind's way of working: G1261 reasoning that became futile (with G2532, and), G5424 understanding to be mature and not childish, G1771 the attitude to arm oneself with.
findings.grounds: arm yourselves with the same way of thinking

findings.obs_text: In 2Cor 12:19 thinking carries G1380, a view held all along, in Phili 1:17 G3633, an intent to afflict, and in Heb 11:15 G3421, being mindful of the land they left.
findings.grounds: If they had been thinking of that land

findings.obs_text: The surface thinks carries H0559 in 1Sa 20:3, Saul's inner speech that David quotes, and in the New Testament G1380 in Luk 8:18, 1Cor 3:18, 1Cor 10:12, 1Cor 14:37, Gal 6:3, Phili 3:4 and Jam 1:26, G3049 in Rom 14:14 and G3543 in 1Cor 7:36. In most of the Greek verses it is a view of oneself that the verse tests: wise, standing, a prophet, something, religious.
findings.grounds: if anyone thinks he is something
